# Account Policy: Test Account

## Account
- account_id: test-account
- spec_version: 0.1

## Goal
Teach small teams to review AI-assisted content responsibly.

## Audience
Small content teams.

## Platform
LinkedIn

## Tone
Clear, practical, and calm.

## Language
English

## Constraints
- Do not promise guaranteed results.
- Keep a human responsible for publication.

## Banned Terms
- guaranteed

## Required Hashtags
- #ResponsibleAI

## Examples
- Write the policy first, then review every generated claim.

## Rubric
- policy_compliance: 40
- clarity: 30
- usefulness: 20
- originality: 10

## Threshold
80

## Maximum Length
900

## Model Route
- research: gemini
- copywriter: groq
- critic: github_models
